verdict.rationale: Modal's docs make strong scale claims (hundreds of thousands of concurrent rollout environments, thousands of concurrent runs, opt-in higher-performance backend for higher creation rates/concurrency) and community reports (self-hosted CI runners, MCP-JS agent runtime) show real-world fleet usage, but there is no documented table of concrete concurrency limits, quotas, or per-account/workspace caps — just marketing-level throughput claims. missing for 10: explicit numeric concurrency/quota documentation, official benchmarks or SLAs for large fleets, third-party validation of stated 'hundreds of thousands' figure.
